Contents: If there is reasonable suspicion that there would be an event would be a target of an attack, then yes, surveilance should be used for the safety of anyone attending the event. However, it should be disclaimed in order to notify people that they are being watched.

Part of what makes a plain view exception valid is the officer being at a vantage point legally. If an officer is accessing your computer without warrant or a valid excuse to the 4th amendment, even if they find incriminating evidence it would have been found in violation of the 4th amendment.
